notes.text: Keep the report about approval and the changing names as Heilprin’s account. The Avot material attests the sayings under their short names and the Introduction supplies his grouping. Neither attests this whole report.
Keep the reported dispute and unresolved initials. Mishnah Eduyot 7:6, the passage specified in the Pappias notice, does not name Ben Bag Bag and does not establish the intended referent here.
Preserve Heilprin’s argument from plural wording. The corresponding edition remains open. The checked Tosafot begins with a singular convert and adds an analogy to Bag Bag.
Retain the etymology as attributed to Sefer Hammaarikh. Identified the printed scan of Menahem de Lonzano’s work. Its OCR gave no secure exact locator, so no reader link has been admitted.
